prompt: A rectangular garden measures $20$ feet by $15$ feet. A square patio measuring $5$ feet on each side is built inside it. What is the area, in square feet, of the remaining garden?
hint: Find the whole area, then subtract the part that is no longer garden.

hints.text: Find the whole area, then subtract the part that is no longer garden.

learningObjective: Compute a composite area by subtraction.

alternativeExplanations.title: Subtract the hole, do not rebuild the shape
steps: Trying to carve the remaining region into rectangles works but takes four times as long.
Whole minus hole is the standard move for any shaded-region or leftover-area question.
It also works for circles inside squares, which is the most common version on the test.
